LESSON: LANGUAGE USE 12.3.1 POSSESSIVE PRONOUNS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.3: Language Use 12.3.1 Possessive pronouns
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language Use 12.3.1 Possessive pronouns, part of Strand 12 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do you talk about things that belong to you or other people?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language Use 12.3.1 Possessive pronouns together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: The learner is enriched with the ability to speak clearly and effectively as they construct sentences using

possessive pronouns.

• Learning to learn: The learner’s ability to build relationships is boosted as they role play ownership of items and objects in the classroom with

peers.

Values:
• Social justice is developed as the learner fosters fairness and non-discrimination to peers when playing language games.

94

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Life skills (Self-esteem): The learner acquires an enhanced level of self-esteem as they use possessive pronouns correctly in communication.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner links the concept of possessive pronouns to learning of similar concepts in Kiswahili and Indigenous Language Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources

• Print textbooks in appropriate font size and colour contrast

• Braille books

• Digital devices with assistive technology,

• Charts, flash cards or braille cards,

• Pictures or picture description
